The M Collection

Collections
Welcome to The M Collection, an exclusive auction offering some of the most sought-after and legendary BMW models from the 1990s and early 2000s. Here, you have the opportunity to acquire some of BMW's most iconic sports cars – each with its own unique history and design.
Bidders HighwayApril 08, 2025 10:00

From the rare and well-preserved BMW M5 E34 3.8 in Cosmo Black, which represents the final chapter of the E34 M5's history, to the exclusive BMW 540i Touring in Daytona Violet, one of only 10 with a manual transmission – this auction features some true rarities for collectors and enthusiasts. We also present a highly sought-after BMW 325i Coupé AVUS Edition, a special model with Motorsport details, as well as the iconic BMW M5 E39 in LeMans Blue, still one of the most revered M cars of all time.

Each car in this collection offers not only performance and driving pleasure but also the potential to become a future collector's item. With carefully documented histories, well-preserved condition, and unique specifications, these vehicles represent the pinnacle of BMW's engineering and design.

Don't miss the chance to be part of this exclusive collection.

BMW M5 E34 3.8 – Cosmo Svart, NO RESERVE

The final evolution of a legend – this 1995 BMW M5 E34 3.8 represents the pinnacle of the hand-built M5 era. Manufactured on July 15, 1994, and registered as a 1995 model, this is not only one of the most sought-after versions of the E34 M5 but also one of only 404 left-hand drive sedans produced in the final production year.

Under the hood, the larger 3.8-liter engine (S38B38) delivers 340 horsepower to the rear wheels through a six-speed manual gearbox – one of BMW's most beloved drivetrains of all time. This particular example is painted in classic Cosmo Black metallic and is sold completely without reserve, making it a unique opportunity for those seeking a modern classic with potential to increase in value.

The car was imported from Germany in 1999 and has had six owners since then. It was owned by the same person for a decade after the import, and has been consistently documented with inspection reports and receipts. The current odometer reading shows 355,605 km – a high mileage, but also a testament to the car's usage and care. It comes with a binder containing receipts totaling over 140,000 SEK in maintenance and repairs. The service book is missing, but the well-documented history compensates for this.

A collectible M5 in the right specification – and a rare chance to acquire one of the last true M cars from an era when engineering took precedence over cost savings.

BMW 540i Touring – Daytona Violet, 6-speed manual, 1 of 10, NO RESERVE AUCTION

When practicality meets enthusiasm. This 1996 BMW E34 540i Touring combines practical features with performance and exclusivity in a way few cars manage. Under the hood sits a powerful 4.0-liter V8, and – most importantly – it's paired with a six-speed manual gearbox. An unusual configuration in itself, but in this particular version, it becomes even more unique: the car is painted in Daytona Violet Metallic, and according to available statistics, this is one of only ten 540i Tourings delivered in this color combination with a manual transmission.

Only 499 units of the E34 540i Touring were produced, which already makes the model a collector's item. Add the striking color, transmission, and the car's excellent condition, and you have a top-class enthusiast vehicle. And the best part? The car is sold completely without reserve.

The condition is excellent both inside and out. The car is well-documented, and recently completed service work ensures that it is ready to be enjoyed – whether on the open road or in a collection.

A rare yet practical youngtimer, with clear upside for those who value a combination of character, engine sound, and cargo space.

BMW 325i Coupé AVUS Edition – Boston Green, 1 of a few special models

A BMW for the connoisseur. This 1995 BMW E36 325i Coupé AVUS Edition is a rare and well-documented special model produced in a very limited number as a complement to the homologated Class 2 series. Under the hood sits a 2.5-liter inline-six, which in this lighter coupé body delivers classic BMW driving experience – refined with unique AVUS details both inside and out.

The equipment code S766A confirms that this is an authentic AVUS Edition – a model characterized by the BMW Motorsport International package, including the M-package skirt kit and mirrors, as well as a unique interior with motorsport influences. This car is also painted in Boston Green metallic – a color that enhances its discreet yet sporty look.

The car was manufactured in 1994 and imported from Germany. It has had eight owners and is now in very good condition, with only 185,000 km on the odometer, something confirmed by a well-maintained service book and extensive documentation.

This is a rare opportunity to acquire an authentic special model from BMW's golden era of the 90s – a car that, with its combination of lightness, balance, and design, stands out even among collectors.

BMW M5 E39 – Le Mans Blue

The last of the analog M cars? This 2003 BMW M5 E39 is at least a strong argument for that. With its naturally aspirated 4.9-liter V8 (S62) delivering 400 horsepower, a six-speed manual gearbox, and rear-wheel drive, this sports sedan still sets the standard – both in terms of feel and balance.

This example is painted in the classic Le Mans Blue metallic, a color that truly enhances the lines of the E39 body. The condition is excellent, the history is documented, and the car comes with a complete equipment list. It offers an unbeatable combination of comfort and performance – a car that feels just as at home on long trips as on winding country roads.

With only six days left on the auction, this is an opportunity not to be missed. E39 M5s in the right specification are becoming increasingly sought after, and this is an example that fits perfectly in both an enthusiast's garage and as a reliable everyday classic.

One of BMW's most revered models – now available at auction.
